# Exact full-rank seam replay, part B (part A followed by this block verifies the application too)

This contains the complete 135 numerical tuples of the original order-ten input. Concatenate A's code and then this ES2020 block before running Node. It independently isolates the chronologically changed forward prefix on the same physical 13-node mesh, proves all its divisions nonzero and dirty ranks large enough, checks all 3,047 ordinary trees through size eleven at the claimed budgets, and also tests the three Hermite-blind directions of the real typed 24-row example. The existing 51-stage input reconstruction is retained as a separate control.
